models.licence_note: Canary-1B-v2 is NVIDIA's model (CC-BY-4.0, attribution required); this is the ONNX export by istupakov. Its outputs carry no restriction.
models.note: NVIDIA Canary-1B-v2 (about 1B parameters) on onnxruntime, int8 files by default (1.0 GB; full precision 4 GB): clean text with punctuation and capitals in 25 European languages, no fillers or repetitions. The Czech FLEURS word error rate on its model card is 7.86% (self-reported, read speech). About 4 times slower than Parakeet on a CPU, and the more accurate of the two. onnx-asr gives it no token times: the words are timed by the align stage (forced alignment).

models.licence_note: Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 is NVIDIA's model (CC-BY-4.0, attribution required); this is the ONNX export by istupakov. Its outputs carry no restriction.
models.note: NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 (0.6B parameters) on onnxruntime, int8 files by default (0.7 GB; full precision 2.6 GB): the same 25 languages as Canary, finds the language itself, much faster (tens of times real time on a CPU), a little less accurate.
pyannote.audio 4.x. Gated: accept the conditions on Hugging Face and provide a token (HF_TOKEN). Gives full (overlapping) and exclusive diarization.

models.licence_note: model weights CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Wang et al., Wespeaker, ICASSP 2023); trained on VoxCeleb2, whose site describes it as for research purposes, with the audio's copyright held by the original YouTube uploaders. Check that this fits your use.
models.note: WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM speaker embeddings (26.5 MB ONNX, not gated) + flexasr's clustering. Trained on VoxCeleb2; see the licence note. Needs onnxruntime; no account.

WhisperX forced alignment with its default wav2vec2 model per language (models downloaded by whisperx; licences differ per language). Fallback aligner; better ones (Qwen3-ForcedAligner, NeMo FA) planned.
